articles.description:
The War Songs of Greenwich Village


This post is a teaser for some seriously awesome folk history—“The War Songs of Greenwich Village” promises a deep dive into the storytelling anthems that rose up in the Village. Think protest, heartbreak and hard-won hope set to acoustic guitars and tin whistles.
Hungry for more? Grab Noah Lefevre’s Century of Song from Barnes & Noble, Blackwells, Amazon or Indigo to keep the vibes rolling—and while you’re at it, spin Dancing Willow’s take on “The Foggy Dew” for a taste of Village-style rebellion.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Polyphonic: The War Songs of Greenwich Village

Plus, it’s your final shot at 50% off The Scale Matrix—3.5+ hours covering 25+ scales and modes—before the early-access price disappears at midnight ET.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Rick Beato: Escape the Pentatonic Trap in One Lesson

articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
Can We Beat the US Junior Champion?


Bryan and his team had an epic day teeing off alongside the US Junior Champion—an experience they called “so cool” and full of surprises on the course. Between jaw-dropping shots and friendly banter, they put their skills to the test and shared every moment of the challenge.
Beyond the round itself, Bryan invites fans to join his community—newsletter, Discord, Twitch and socials—and plugs all their favorite gear sponsors, from launch monitors and laser rangefinders to custom putters, gloves and apparel. Don’t miss out on the discount codes and behind-the-scenes fun!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Bryan Bros Golf: Can We Beat the US Junior Champion?

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Silent Hill f ramps up the tension with five very different endings—four packed with distinct boss battles plus a surprise UFO finale. You’ll face the haunting Shiromuku (twice if you dare), the shape-shifting Tsukumogami, the relentless Shichibi and even a showdown “with the gods,” all while sneaking in a sly Shiba Inu cameo.
Time stamps from 0:00 (“Coming Home To Roost”) to 1:18:00 (UFO Ending) break down every twist: “Fox’s Wedding,” “The Fox Wets Its Tail,” “Ebisugaoka In Silence” and a post-credit clash to seal the deal. Dive in, pick your path and witness Silent Hill f’s full roster of scares.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: GameSpot: Silent Hill f - All Endings With Boss Fights

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
IGN’s got the scoop on the nine best Silent Hill titles that’ll make your skin crawl, riding high on the hype from 2024’s Silent Hill 2 remake and the fresh Silent Hill f. After nearly 30 years of crafting feel-bad survival horror, they’re digging through Konami’s catalogue to rank the creepiest, most unforgettable scares.
They’ve ditched the forgettable flops—goodbye Homecoming, Downpour, The Arcade and Book of Memories—and picked only the cream of the creepy crop. If you’re craving spine-tingling thrills, this is your ultimate Silent Hill hit list.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Top 9 Silent Hill Games

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Get hyped – Borderlands 4 just dropped a first look at C4SH, the explosive new Vault Hunter blasting onto the scene. She’s the first of two fresh faces gearing up to rip through Pandora’s mayhem.
C4SH arrives in the game’s inaugural Story Pack, Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned, slated for Q1 2026. Meanwhile, the base game is already live on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version landing October 3.

The game launches October 10 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam), marking the next major entry from Battlefield Studios, DICE and EA.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Battlefield 6 - Official Launch Live Action Trailer (Ft. Zac Efron, Jimmy Butler, Morgan Wallen)

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Mars Tactics just dropped its second official gameplay trailer, giving us a closer look at its retro-style tactical strategy set during a workers’ uprising on Mars. The footage highlights new management and squad-customization mechanics, so you can tailor your crew and resources as you fight for control of the red planet.
Mark your calendars: Mars Tactics will launch on PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store) in May 2026. #IGN #Gaming
Watch on YouTube

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Blood: Refreshed Supply Announcement Trailer


Get ready to dive back into the gruesome 2.5D shooter world of Blood with Blood: Refreshed Supply, a slick remaster of the cult classic. The new trailer teases fresh levels, community-created mods and a peek at various revamped episodes — perfect for fans craving extra carnage. 
Launching soon on PlayStation 5 & 4, Xbox, Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam, GOG, Humble Store & Epic Games Store), this one’s shaping up to be a bloody good time. Stay tuned!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Blood: Refreshed Supply - Official Announcement Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:

Get a sneak peek at Threads of Time, a charming turn-based RPG that sends you hopping across eras to recruit a motley crew of heroes. The new trailer teases strategic battles, time-bending story twists, and a villainous plot that could tear past, present, and future apart all at once.
Launching on PC via Steam and Xbox Series X/S, Threads of Time looks set to become your next must-play time-travel adventure.
Watch on YouTube
